---
title: "Numerical Methods Explorer"
subtitle: "Euler, modified Euler (RK2), and RK4 for first-order initial value problems"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Choose an equation $x' = f(t,x)$, then adjust the step size $h$ and the initial condition to compare Euler's method, the modified Euler (RK2) method, and RK4 against the exact solution. Use the tabs to view solution curves, the log--log convergence plot, a step-by-step table, and the formulas.
